# Azelis is the reference innovation service provider in the speciality chemicals and food
# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]
* [International supply chain][79]

.

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

.

### Customer Portal

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.
From one digital experience you can order samples, request quotes and reorder products from Azelis.

Register at [Explore.Azelis.com][82]

[Visit the Customer Portal ][83]

.

### Sustainability

At Azelis, we are committed to maintaining high human, environmental and ethical values. That is
only possible thanks to the cooperation of local communities, industry bodies, authorities, and/or
regulators, and with you.* *
* [Our sustainability programme][84]
* [Our 2025 Integrated Report][85]

## We are Azelis

Together with our 65,000+ customers we provide effective, sustainable and reliable business
solutions, developing innovative ways to create value. We are Azelis.

We currently employ more than 4,100 people across the world in 64 countries. We value highly
competent, forward-looking people.

Are you looking to work for a highly dynamic and innovative company where you can unleash your
talent? [Then you’re in the right place.][93]

### Corporate social responsibility

We take our responsibilities seriously and work with employees and stakeholders to reduce the
environmental impact of our work and to improve the social value in what we do, wherever we get the
opportunity.

***Against slavery and human trafficking***

We are committed to ensuring modern slavery does not take place within our business or supply
chains.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Brenntag is the global market leader in chemicals and ingredients distribution and holds a central role in connecting customers and suppliers of the chemical industry. Headquartered in Essen, Germany, we have more than 18,100 employees worldwide and operate a network of around 600 sites in more than 70 countries. In 2024, the company generated sales of €16.2 billion. The two global divisions, Brenntag Essentials and Brenntag Specialties, provide a diversified and broad portfolio of industrial and specialty chemicals and ingredients as well as tailor-made application, marketing and supply chain solutions, technical and formulation support, comprehensive regulatory know-how and digital solutions for a wide range of industries. Brenntag pursues an ambitious sustainability agenda and is committed to sustainable solutions in its own sector and the industries served. Brenntag SE shares have been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2010 and have been part of the DAX since September 2021. In addition, the Brenntag SE shares are listed in the DAX 30 ESG and DAX ESG Target.

# The trusted global distributor and development partner for ingredients and specialty chemical
# solutions

At Caldic, partnerships come first. We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to enable
them to bring breakthrough innovations to market across the life science and material science
sectors. By combining technical expertise, local presence and a people-driven mindset, we go beyond
supply chain excellence to spark what’s next in healthier living and sustainable materials. 

[Explore our solutions][37]

## We go beyond distribution to co-create solutions that enable our customers to create entirely new
## product categories.
* ### Co-create tailored solutions
  
  We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to develop tailored solutions grounded in deep
  technical, market, and local expertise.
* ### Breakthrough innovations
  
  With over 70 application laboratories worldwide, our R&D teams co-create formulations that deliver
  superior quality and greater market value.
* ### Beyond supply chain excellence
  
  Our advanced supply chain facilities deliver custom-blended and packed solutions that reduce
  complexity, accelerate speed-to-market and get high-quality products production-ready.
* ### Global reach, local precision
  
  With teams in 44 countries, we combine global sourcing with local delivery to scale fast and meet
  market demands with deep insight and technical agility.

## Our Sustainability Report 2025 is here

Discover how we're turning our purpose, 'Because we care', into measurable progress across our
business. Explore our latest sustainability achievements, ESG initiatives, and the actions we're
taking to create long-term value for our people, customers, partners, and communities.

[**Read the report**][38]

[Cover page of the Caldic Sustainability Report 2025 showcasing the company’s sustainability
performance, ESG priorities, and commitment to responsible growth across its global operations]

## Solutions that go beyond distribution 

By connecting our market insight and entrepreneurial mindset with our deep customer understanding,
we develop tailored solutions across food, (bio)pharma, personal care and industrial applications.
From formulation to delivery, every detail reflects our care. With insight and agility, we help
simplify supply chains and unlock value at every step. 

[Discover our market solutions][39]

## Rooted in local teams, connected across the globe 

With teams in 44 countries and facilities across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific, we combine
global sourcing with local last-mile delivery. Our on-the-ground experts build strong customer
relationships and respond with speed, insight and precision. From sourcing and reformulating to
blending, labeling and resizing, our regional agility drives growth in dynamic, fast-moving markets.
We deliver fast, custom solutions - from bakery mixes to specialty pharma-grade solvents for nearby
hospital hubs. 

[Discover our global reach][40]

_crawl.linkedin_about: YOUR NEW EMPLOYER FOR A SHARED FUTURE The DOLDER GROUP - headquartered in Basel (Switzerland) - provides raw materials, plastic granulates, and additives for the chemical, plastics, and rubber industries. We also provide intelligent solutions for the environment. We are proud on our subsidiaries in Saronno/Milan (Italy), Istanbul (Turkey), and Barcelona (Spain). OUR STRONGEST ASSET Our people are the foundation of our success. Their expertise, knowledge, commitment, and entrepreneurial mindset create value for our customers, suppliers, and colleagues every day. We offer meaningful work in an international environment with short decision-making paths, where collaboration and individual contribution are equally valued. OUR CULTURE Our culture is shaped by the values we live every day: fairness, equality, reliability, transparency, and trust. We believe in building long-term relationships with customers, suppliers, and colleagues alike. Team spirit is reflected in how we collaborate across functions and countries, support one another, and work together to achieve shared goals. With strong roots and an agile mindset, we combine stability with modern ways of working. YOUR FUTURE Dolder is more than an employer. We are a company where people and business grow together. We invest in development, encourage initiative, and create opportunities for our employees to expand their skills, take responsibility, and make a meaningful impact.

##### ENTER THE DISTRICT

##### [ITALY][71] [GERMANY][72] [CZECH REPUBLIC][73] [CHINA][74] [SPAIN][75] [USA][76]

**Global chemicals distributors**

Since 1926, **Faravelli Group** has specialized in the **distribution of ingredients and chemical
raw materials for industry**, supporting companies worldwide in their growth and helping them stand
out in increasingly complex markets.

Founded in Milan in 1926 by **Giusto Faravelli**, the Group has grown from a family-owned Italian
company into an **international organization**, while preserving a strong identity rooted in its
origins.

Headquartered in Milan, Faravelli Group operates through a network of directly owned companies in
**Italy, Germany, the Czech Republic, the Slovak Republic, Hungary, Spain, China and the United
States**.
This structure allows us to act as a truly integrated group, combining global reach with local
expertise and proximity to our customers.

Across all markets, Faravelli Group is active in the distribution of ingredients and chemical raw
materials for the **food, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, animal nutrition and industrial
chemical sectors**, offering technical expertise and deep market knowledge tailored to each industry
and geography.

Over the past hundred years, technologies, markets and business needs have evolved.
What has never changed is the Group’s way of working: **attention to people, uncompromising quality
standards, transparency and the ability to build solid, long-lasting relationships** with customers
and partners.

Today, Faravelli Group is **more than a distributor**. We are a **strategic partner**, providing an
integrated approach that combines top-quality ingredients with **technical support, application
consultancy, marketing, innovation and efficient logistics solutions**. This approach enables our
customers to move confidently from formulation to market — all the way to the final consumer.

In 2026, Faravelli Group celebrates **one hundred years of history** — not as a finish line, but as
a new starting point.
Always alongside companies, with vision and expertise, helping them grow, compete and **stand out**.

**Stand out with Faravelli Group, your best ingredient.**

**Global chemicals distributors**

Since 1926, **Faravelli Group** has specialized in the **distribution of ingredients and chemical
raw materials for industry**, supporting companies worldwide in their growth and helping them stand
out in increasingly complex markets.

Founded in Milan in 1926 by **Giusto Faravelli**, the Group has grown from a family-owned Italian
company into an **international organization**, while preserving a strong identity rooted in its
origins.

Headquartered in Milan, Faravelli Group operates through a network of directly owned companies in
**Italy, Germany, the Czech Republic, the Slovak Republic, Hungary, Spain, China and the United
States**.
This structure allows us to act as a truly integrated group, combining global reach with local
expertise and proximity to our customers.

Across all markets, Faravelli Group is active in the distribution of ingredients and chemical raw
materials for the **food, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, animal nutrition and industrial
chemical sectors**, offering technical expertise and deep market knowledge tailored to each industry
and geography.

Over the past hundred years, technologies, markets and business needs have evolved.
What has never changed is the Group’s way of working: **attention to people, uncompromising quality
standards, transparency and the ability to build solid, long-lasting relationships** with customers
and partners.

Today, Faravelli Group is **more than a distributor**. We are a **strategic partner**, providing an
integrated approach that combines top-quality ingredients with **technical support, application
consultancy, marketing, innovation and efficient logistics solutions**. This approach enables our
customers to move confidently from formulation to market — all the way to the final consumer.

In 2026, Faravelli Group celebrates **one hundred years of history** — not as a finish line, but as
a new starting point.
Always alongside companies, with vision and expertise, helping them grow, compete and **stand out**.

**Stand out with Faravelli Group, your best ingredient.**

Across eight Business Groups*, its market specialists collaborate with suppliers and customers to help co-formulate solutions that embrace industry trends. Listed at Euronext, Amsterdam (IMCD), IMCD realised revenues of EUR 4,727 million in 2024 with over 5,126 employees in over 60 countries on six continents. IMCD's dedicated technical and commercial experts work in close partnership to tailor best-in-class solutions for around 60,000 customers and a diverse range of world-class suppliers. For you, and for us, we are creating a world of opportunity. *Our business groups are Home Care and I&I, Beauty & Personal Care, Food & Nutrition, Advanced Materials, Coatings & Construction, Pharmaceuticals, Lubricants & Energy and Industrial Solutions.

# **Welcome to Jebsen & Jessen Ingredients**

****

**Jebsen & Jessen Ingredients** is a leading distributor and solutions provider of specialty
chemicals and life science ingredients in Southeast Asia. We connect global technology leaders with

# Welcome to K K Chem India Pvt Ltd.

We are among the fastest growing chemical distribution companies in India.

[Our Principals][9]

## About Us

K K Chem India Pvt Ltd. (formerly K. K. Chempro (I) Pvt. Ltd. (ISO 9001 company)) is one of the
fastest growing speciality chemical distribution companies in India and represents the most reputed
global chemical companies for various regions and product lines. The company and its group of
companies and diversification have reached a turnover of nearly 30 million USD.

KKCIPL specialises in distributing Silicone/Acrylic/Silica/Surfactants/Amines/Solvents and many more
chemistries in the diversified market. The major market coverage is with Convertors. The industries
catered to are PAPER/PLASTICS/TEXTILES/AGRO/CONSTRUCTION/CHEMICAL INTERMEDIATES/PETROLEUM and many
more.

KKCIPL has received several accolades from its PRINCIPALS for new product launches, technical
support, development and identifying market gaps.

[Company Information][10]

K K Chem India Pvt Ltd. has successfully completed the assessment conducted by Great Place To Work®,
India, and is certified as a great workplace.

Category: Under 100 Employees

[View Certification][11]

## Our Principals

#### Over the years, we have partnered with a global network of distributors to ensure we can
#### deliver anywhere around the world. Each of our channel partners bestows us with 100% of their
#### trust.

[][12]

#### [Dow Consumer Solutions][13]

Dow Consumer Solutions represents silicone-based product lines under the brand name ‘Dowsil’. Its
top market constitutes mobility, building construction & infrastructure, film tapes & release
liners, beauty & personal care and many more.

[Learn More][14]

[][15]

#### [Dow Industrial Solutions][16]

Dow Industrial Solutions contains product lines based on plastics, industrial intermidiates,
polyurethanes, coatings etc.

[Learn More][17]

[][18]

#### [Dupont Multibase][19]

Product line is related to material reinforcement with Si Additives. Various silicone masterbatches
compounds cater to automotive for interior solutions, compounding etc.

[Learn More][20]

[][21]

#### [Evonik][22]

One of the leading & largest companies in the world manufacturing the most specialised fumed and
precipitated silica for different applications such as antifoams, coatings etc.
[Learn More][23]
[][24]

#### [3M][25]

3M is the leading company in the world for speciality textile coatings representing ‘PM (PROTECTIVE
MATERIAL) SERIES’, a fluoro-chemical free chemistry.

[Learn More][26]

[][27]

#### [Clariant][28]

As a global provider of solutions for the textile industry, Clariant offers historical expertise to
improve the quality of fibres and garments.

[Learn More][29]

[][30]

#### [Azelis][31]

A leading chemical distribution company representing key brands of detergent & textile
intermediates.

[Learn More][32]

## Client Testimonials

“My association with K. K. Chemicals goes back more than 17 years. K. K. Chempro and K. K. Chemicals
are very trustworthy, technically qualified company.

Nitin Sethi, the director, is well-versed and has huge infield experience in many silicone products.
The staff is very courteous and helpful in a best possible way.

They have helped us many times with the perfectly right information. My best wishes and full thumbs
up to them.”

 

### Mr. Haresh Sharma, GM – Technical, *Ajit Industries*

“KKCIPL has been a dynamic partner for our growth journey so far.”


### Mr. Paresh Kothari, Director, *Spot On Coatings*, Surat

# Connecting the World.
# For Better Lives.

Manuchar is a leading distributor of chemicals across high-growth markets and actively trades
several other commodities like steel, polymers, and many more. Our scale, infrastructure and
expertise give you the competitive edge you need. Over 40 years of local presence and growth in over
180 locations in North & Latin America, Africa, Europe, the Middle East and Asia prove the value of
our end-to-end commercial, supply chain and financing solutions.

## Manuchar keeps your    production running. Anytime. Anywhere.

Manuchar is a leading distributor of chemicals in high-growth markets. We complement our Chemical
Distribution business with International Trade Services in steel, polymers and several other raw
materials. 

Manuchar is recognized as an exceptionally reliable partner throughout high-growth markets. Our
proven business model is based on deep local market knowledge and a resilient global distribution
and supply chain network, in line with our mission to keep your production running. Anytime.
Anywhere.

[Read more About us][28]

## Chemical Distribution
## One-stop-shop service offering across the value chain

Manuchar is a recognized leader in the local distribution, international trade and logistics of
chemicals in high-growth markets. We serve industries such as Home & Personal Care, Crop Nutrition,
Human Nutrition, Animal Nutrition, Mining & Energy, and other industries. Our Services in Chemical
Distribution cover the full value chain, from sourcing through our 10 sourcing offices up to
just-in-time delivery of goods to your factory.

# Leading International Chemical Suppliers

Norkem is a leading international chemical supplier and distributor and our Head Office is based in
Knutsford, Cheshire in the UK.  We source and stock the highest quality speciality and industrial
chemicals with offices in many parts of the world and are active across six continents.  We obtain
and supply chemicals for a broad spectrum of uses; including the agrochemical, animal feed, food and
drink, industrial, and pharmaceutical industries.  We also produce a range of suspensions and stains
which are primarily used in the brick and building industries.  Our products can be supplied in
various types and sizes of packaging, including bulk deliveries. Due to our global reach as a
chemical distributor, we are effectively able to minimise both the lead and delivery times to
expedite supply to our customers.

At Norkem, we pride ourselves upon our excellent industry knowledge, our highly experienced and
professional sales teams fully understand the products and markets in which we work.  This expertise
means that we are perfectly placed to assist with your enquiries and requirements.

We have excellent long-standing relationships with fully-accredited suppliers and you can depend on
us to reliably source the chemicals that you need at a competitive price.  For further security, we
keep a very close eye on the chemical supply pipelines and have contingency plans in place to ensure
the continuity of supply in our endeavour not to let our customers down.

As a chemical supplier, Norkem is firmly committed to meeting the highest environmental and health
and safety standards. We are also thoroughly dedicated to working towards a more sustainable future
for the chemical distribution industry.

If you would like any further information or assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. You
will find our full contact details available here on our website and a member of staff from one of
our sales teams will be only too pleased to help you. [Contact us now.][59]

# Leading International Chemical Suppliers

Norkem is a leading international chemical supplier and distributor and our Head Office is based in
Knutsford, Cheshire in the UK.  We source and stock the highest quality speciality and industrial
chemicals with offices in many parts of the world and are active across six continents.  We obtain
and supply chemicals for a broad spectrum of uses; including the agrochemical, animal feed, food and
drink, industrial, and pharmaceutical industries.  We also produce a range of suspensions and stains
which are primarily used in the brick and building industries.  Our products can be supplied in
various types and sizes of packaging, including bulk deliveries. Due to our global reach as a
chemical distributor, we are effectively able to minimise both the lead and delivery times to
expedite supply to our customers.

At Norkem, we pride ourselves upon our excellent industry knowledge, our highly experienced and
professional sales teams fully understand the products and markets in which we work.  This expertise
means that we are perfectly placed to assist with your enquiries and requirements.

We have excellent long-standing relationships with fully-accredited suppliers and you can depend on
us to reliably source the chemicals that you need at a competitive price.  For further security, we
keep a very close eye on the chemical supply pipelines and have contingency plans in place to ensure
the continuity of supply in our endeavour not to let our customers down.

As a chemical supplier, Norkem is firmly committed to meeting the highest environmental and health
and safety standards. We are also thoroughly dedicated to working towards a more sustainable future
for the chemical distribution industry.

If you would like any further information or assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. You
will find our full contact details available here on our website and a member of staff from one of
our sales teams will be only too pleased to help you. [Contact us now.][59]

## 80 años a tu servicio

Desde su fundación en 1944, en Quimidroga llevamos 80 años esforzándonos para dar respuesta a las
necesidades de proveedores y clientes. La confianza, la transparencia y el trato familiar, han sido
nuestras herramientas para crecer y construir una compañía que, más allá de distribuir productos
químicos, se dedica a aportar soluciones.

Ahora, ponemos a tu disposición la experiencia acumulada durante todos estos años para ayudarte en
todo aquello que puedas necesitar.

[Conócenos][106]

## Sostenibilidad: la base de nuestra filosofía de negocio

Nuestro compromiso es compartir nuestros conocimientos y recursos a través de la distribución y a la
vez crear y ayudar a crear soluciones sostenibles, cubriendo en la medida de lo posible todos los
puntos del ciclo de vida de un producto, intentando siempre minimizar el impacto medioambiental
generado por nuestra actividad.

El compromiso de Quimidroga con la sostenibilidad va más allá de sus operaciones comerciales y
alcanza a sus comunidades, clientes y representadas.

La simplicidad alcanza otro nivel con [plinko ball][107], un juego donde cada rebote despierta
nuevas sensaciones y mantiene viva la intriga.

## 80 años a tu servicio

Desde su fundación en 1944, en Quimidroga llevamos 80 años esforzándonos para dar respuesta a las
necesidades de proveedores y clientes. La confianza, la transparencia y el trato familiar, han sido
nuestras herramientas para crecer y construir una compañía que, más allá de distribuir productos
químicos, se dedica a aportar soluciones.

Ahora, ponemos a tu disposición la experiencia acumulada durante todos estos años para ayudarte en
todo aquello que puedas necesitar.

[Conócenos][106]

## Sostenibilidad: la base de nuestra filosofía de negocio

Nuestro compromiso es compartir nuestros conocimientos y recursos a través de la distribución y a la
vez crear y ayudar a crear soluciones sostenibles, cubriendo en la medida de lo posible todos los
puntos del ciclo de vida de un producto, intentando siempre minimizar el impacto medioambiental
generado por nuestra actividad.

El compromiso de Quimidroga con la sostenibilidad va más allá de sus operaciones comerciales y
alcanza a sus comunidades, clientes y representadas.

La simplicidad alcanza otro nivel con [plinko ball][107], un juego donde cada rebote despierta
nuevas sensaciones y mantiene viva la intriga.

[Nuestra estrategia de Sostenibilidad][108]

## Who We Are

[REDA Means Satisfaction]REDA Chemicals is a leading distributor of specialty chemicals, uniquely
positioned to serve the specific industrial needs of customers in Asia, the Middle East, and Africa.

With deeply rooted operations in over 30 countries and a dedicated team of more than 750, we manage
a diverse range of specialties from our 100+ strategically located sites — including sales offices,
warehouses, and labs. We oversee a broad spectrum of industries, including food, life sciences,
plastics and rubber, oil and gas, coatings, and construction, and much more.

As trusted chemical distributors, we represent renowned global manufacturers, extending their reach
and ensuring local markets have access to the high-quality materials they deserve.

**We are the bridge between global producers and local industries, facilitating innovation and
development by supplying essential chemicals to the markets that need them most.**

Proudly extending our sales to over 50 countries, we are committed to being the reliable partner for
our customers, offering global reach with local insights. In a challenging marketplace, REDA
Chemicals stands as your partner in advancing industrial capabilities efficiently and effectively.

## Einkauf

Wenn es auf Ihrer Liste steht,
können wir es beschaffen


Auch beim Einkauf zahlt sich die große Erfahrung und weltweite Präsenz von TER Chemicals für Sie
aus: Schnelle Warenverfügbarkeit durch Lagerhaltung eines breiten Portfolios und konstante
marktgerechte Preise sind bei uns selbstverständlich. Im Sinne der Planungs- und Produktsicherheit
veröffentlichen wir Rohstoff-Preisprognosen (für Importe) und geben Spezifikationsgarantien. Für
unsere Key Account beschaffen wir auch gern ganze Jahreskontingente. Die Zahlungsziele für unsere
Kunden gestalten wir dabei individuell nach Kontext. Zudem sichern wir Transaktionen ggf. mit
Mitteln der Währungssicherung sowie mit Kreditversicherungen (Euler Hermes) ab. Nicht zuletzt diese
Sorgfalt sowie ein strenges Qualitätsmanagement, zu dem auch wiederkehrende Lieferantenaudits (für
Importe) gehören, haben uns zu einem weltweit renommierten Importeur gemacht.

## Vertrieb

Ihr direkter Weg
zum Kunden

Als Kenner des Marktes der Rohstoffe, Spezialchemikalien und deren Formulierungen können wir Sie mit
unserem Know-how auch bei Produkteinführungen und Marktausweitungen beraten und unterstützen. Dazu
gehören Wettbewerbsbeobachtungen, Marktreporte und Marktpotenzialbewertungen ebenso wie effektives
Online-Marketing (www.lanuco.de) oder Präsenz auf Messen. Dank unserer hohen Marktdurchdringung
haben wir dabei in Europa einen besonders guten Kundenzugang. Für unsere Serviceleistungen im
Vertrieb beschäftigen wir ein spezialisiertes Team – bestehend aus Key Supplier Management, Product
Management und Account Management –  das sich durch fundierte Fachkenntnisse und exzellente
Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auszeichnet.

## Logistik

DAS GANZE PAKET –
EFFIZIENZ, TERMINTREUE, UMFASSENDER SERVICE

Logistik ist ein ganz wesentlicher Bestandteil unseres Leistungsspektrums. Über unsere dezentralen
Lagerhäuser bieten wir unseren Kunden termingerechte bzw. just-in-time Belieferung selbst bei
komplizierten Anforderungen. Dabei sind auch direkte Streckenlieferungen vom Hersteller zu unserem
Kunden möglich ­– weltweit. Doch unser Service beginnt schon früher. So gehören das Umfüllen auf
Kleingebinde (z.T. GMP-konform), das Umverpacken (ggf. mit kundenindividuelle Etiketten), die
Produktveredelung (Zerkleinern, Mischen, Vermahlen, Verflockung), die Konfektionierung gemischter
Paletten, sowie die optimierte Feindistribution von Kleinmengen ebenso zu unseren Leistungen. Unser
hohes Serviceniveau wird garantiert durch speziell ausgebildete Logistikfachleute und eine strenge
Qualitätssicherung. Seit 2011 sind wir AEO-zertifiziert. Mit der LZ Logistik GmbH verfügt unsere
Unternehmensgruppe seit 2014 zudem über ein eigenes Logistikunternehmen, das sich insbesondere um
die Abwicklung des Lagergeschäftes an unserem Firmensitz und Hafenstandort Hamburg kümmert.

## Einkauf

Wenn es auf Ihrer Liste steht,
können wir es beschaffen


Auch beim Einkauf zahlt sich die große Erfahrung und weltweite Präsenz von TER Chemicals für Sie
aus: Schnelle Warenverfügbarkeit durch Lagerhaltung eines breiten Portfolios und konstante
marktgerechte Preise sind bei uns selbstverständlich. Im Sinne der Planungs- und Produktsicherheit
veröffentlichen wir Rohstoff-Preisprognosen (für Importe) und geben Spezifikationsgarantien. Für
unsere Key Account beschaffen wir auch gern ganze Jahreskontingente. Die Zahlungsziele für unsere
Kunden gestalten wir dabei individuell nach Kontext. Zudem sichern wir Transaktionen ggf. mit
Mitteln der Währungssicherung sowie mit Kreditversicherungen (Euler Hermes) ab. Nicht zuletzt diese
Sorgfalt sowie ein strenges Qualitätsmanagement, zu dem auch wiederkehrende Lieferantenaudits (für
Importe) gehören, haben uns zu einem weltweit renommierten Importeur gemacht.

## Vertrieb

Ihr direkter Weg
zum Kunden

Als Kenner des Marktes der Rohstoffe, Spezialchemikalien und deren Formulierungen können wir Sie mit
unserem Know-how auch bei Produkteinführungen und Marktausweitungen beraten und unterstützen. Dazu
gehören Wettbewerbsbeobachtungen, Marktreporte und Marktpotenzialbewertungen ebenso wie effektives
Online-Marketing (www.lanuco.de) oder Präsenz auf Messen. Dank unserer hohen Marktdurchdringung
haben wir dabei in Europa einen besonders guten Kundenzugang. Für unsere Serviceleistungen im
Vertrieb beschäftigen wir ein spezialisiertes Team – bestehend aus Key Supplier Management, Product
Management und Account Management –  das sich durch fundierte Fachkenntnisse und exzellente
Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auszeichnet.

## Logistik

DAS GANZE PAKET –
EFFIZIENZ, TERMINTREUE, UMFASSENDER SERVICE

Logistik ist ein ganz wesentlicher Bestandteil unseres Leistungsspektrums. Über unsere dezentralen
Lagerhäuser bieten wir unseren Kunden termingerechte bzw. just-in-time Belieferung selbst bei
komplizierten Anforderungen. Dabei sind auch direkte Streckenlieferungen vom Hersteller zu unserem
Kunden möglich ­– weltweit. Doch unser Service beginnt schon früher. So gehören das Umfüllen auf
Kleingebinde (z.T. GMP-konform), das Umverpacken (ggf. mit kundenindividuelle Etiketten), die
Produktveredelung (Zerkleinern, Mischen, Vermahlen, Verflockung), die Konfektionierung gemischter
Paletten, sowie die optimierte Feindistribution von Kleinmengen ebenso zu unseren Leistungen. Unser
hohes Serviceniveau wird garantiert durch speziell ausgebildete Logistikfachleute und eine strenge
Qualitätssicherung. Seit 2011 sind wir AEO-zertifiziert. Mit der LZ Logistik GmbH verfügt unsere
Unternehmensgruppe seit 2014 zudem über ein eigenes Logistikunternehmen, das sich insbesondere um
die Abwicklung des Lagergeschäftes an unserem Firmensitz und Hafenstandort Hamburg kümmert.

## Produkt­entwicklung

GEMEINSAME INNOVATIONEN FÜR
EINE BESSERE ZUKUNFT

Sie haben ein innovatives Produkt oder Verfahren, das zu uns passen könnte? Ihre Idee bietet
gegenüber konventionellen Produkten klare Vorteile, wie einen deutlich geringeren CO2-Fußabdruck –
Stichwort "low-carbon production"? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen und austauschen. Wir freuen uns
auf Sie!

Das TER Chemicals-Anwendungslabor. Von Anfang an unterstützend an Ihrer Seite.
Bei der Auswahl von Rohstoffen oder der Erstellung einer Formulierung bevorzugen Sie eine
individuelle Beratung? Unser Know-how im Bereich der Kosmetika versetzt uns in die Lage, sowohl
unsere Kunden als auch unsere Lieferanten bei der Produktentwicklung wirkungsvoll zu unterstützen.
Unsere Leistungen reichen dabei von der Bereitstellung von Produktmustern und der
Formulierungsberatung und -entwicklung über die Durchführung von Produktversuchen mit anschließender
Lieferung von Prototypen bis hin zu Kundentests. Im TER Chemicals-Anwendungslabor am Standort
Flörsheim am Main verfolgen unsere erfahrenen Anwendungstechniker/-innen, Ingenieure/-innen und
Produktentwickler/-innen jeden Tag aufs Neue ein gemeinsames Ziel: die perfekte Lösung zu finden. 
Besuchen Sie auch gern unsere [Formulierungsdatenbank][36] mit innovativen Richtrahmenrezepturen für
vielseitige kosmetische Anwendungen. In unserem [Newsroom][37] berichten wir zudem regelmäßig über
Produkt- und Rohstofftrends. Schauen Sie doch einmal vorbei.

## The UK's Leading Independent Chemical Distributor

View more

***Delivering every element***

 

Tennants Distribution is a leading independent distributor of chemicals with a strategically located
network of depots across the UK, ensuring a fast and efficient delivery service.

The Tennant Group began in 1797 when Charles Tennant invented a stable process for bleaching cloth;
a revolutionary process at the time, transforming the textile industry, at the time Tennants were
the largest chemical manufacturer in the world.

Since then, the Tennant Group has remained a successful, independent chemical company and Tennants
Distribution are the leading independent distributor of chemicals in the UK.

Distribution are the leading independent distributor of chemicals in the UK.

## Our purpose is to sustainably and efficiently connect the world with essential goods.

We add value to our suppliers and customers through providing superior logistics, risk management,
financing, and market intelligence services. We originate and market products globally, meeting
specific location, quality, timing and volume requirements. We also provide a versatile range of
price risk management and contracting alternatives to our clients. Every day, we strive to enhance
international commerce through the physical movement and marketing of industrial chemicals, fuels,
plastic intermediates, and fertilizers. We are committed to providing our clients and suppliers with
streamlined services, so they can focus on their core business. With our worldwide team of
professionals, we have grown from a business that began with distribution of caustic soda, to a
globally recognized company, trading hundreds of products.

Company Overview
[Company Overview]

#### LOGISTICS

Logistics management is a key activity and core competence in our business. Our expertise covers
multiple modes of transport, including railcars, barges, and both dry bulk and liquids vessels. We
recently created Lighthouse, a freight brokerage joint venture, continuing to strengthen our
capabilities in this critical area.

#### MARKET INTELLIGENCE

Our extended coverage around the world, with presence across numerous markets provides us with
unique insights and allows us to spot valuable opportunities. We carefully cultivate relationships
with market participants, including via sponsorship and participation of several industry
conferences.

#### RISK MANAGEMENT

We manage various risks in our operations, including price risk, credit, liquidity and operational
risks. The goal of our process is to minimize costs for our suppliers and customers, while reducing
uncertainty inherent in the commodity trade flows we handle.

#### Financing

Inherent to our business we provide various forms of financing to our customers and suppliers.  We
participate in prepayment arrangements, secured financing structures, and provide open account
terms.

and technical expertise, allowing us to deliver added-value for both our suppliers and customers.

# Innovation in Chemistry. Value in Service.

Delivering high-performance chemical programs and unmatched field service to optimize asset
lifecycle and production.

[Partner With Us][17]

#### Solutions Built Around Your Challenges.

Smart Chemical Services is an enterprise-scale manufacturer engineered to replace off-the-shelf
products with tailored chemistry programs. We bridge the gap between scientific design and field
execution by integrating advanced laboratory diagnostics, a private logistics fleet, and continuous
technical stewardship. By aligning molecular science directly with your operational data, we
eliminate downtime, protect downhole infrastructure, and drastically reduce your total cost of
ownership.

## From Lab to Wellbore: What We Do

We collaborate directly with your team to reduce the total cost of ownership across every phase of
the well lifecycle. By aligning advanced chemistry, field operations, and performance data, we
engineer customized chemical programs tailored to your precise operational requirements. Whether
deploying high-intensity completions fluids, optimizing drill-out sweeping efficiency, securing
long-term flow assurance for production, or managing downstream fuels and commodities, we deliver
the optimal results that maximize daily efficiency, lift performance, and long-term asset
reliability.

Our core capabilities include:

[

### Completion Chemical Services

We engineer advanced fracturing fluid chemistry and deploy highvolume injection infrastructure
designed to accelerate time to first oil, compress completion timelines, and protect long-term
reservoir permeability.

][18] [Contact a Chemical Expert][19]
[

### Drill-Out Chemical Services

Formulated to eliminate torque and drag boundaries in extendedreach laterals. Our specialized fluid
systems suspend composite remnants and maximize sweeping efficiency to ensure rapid, fail-safe
wellbore cleanout.

][20] [Contact a Drill-Out Expert][21]
[

### Production Chemical Services

Continuous asset protection and flow assurance designed to maximize lifecycle recovery. We couple
lab-qualified downhole diagnostics with real-time digital transparency to proactively mitigate
scale, corrosion, and paraffin hazards.

][22] [Contact a Production Expert][23]
[

### Fuel & Commodity Services

Comprehensive downstream fuel additive technologies and secure, large-scale commodity supply chains.
We deliver unmatched direct-to-terminal logistics control to preserve fluid quality and protect
midstream transportation loops.

][24] [Contact a Fuel Expert][25]

## The Smart Advantage: Technical Stewardship Across the Life-of-Well.

We bridge the gap between molecular diagnostics and field execution to deliver a comprehensive
framework for asset integrity.

### Integrated Laboratory Insights & R&D Depth

Every program begins in our laboratory. From our Midland Technical Center to our Ennis Innovation
Hub, we perform detailed mineralogical and fluid analyses on your specific reservoir properties to
engineer qualified, performance-driven chemistry.

### Specialized Production & Life-of-Well Support

We deliver seamless fluid lifecycle management across every phase—from high-intensity stimulation
and rapid drill-outs to continuous flow assurance, midstream transport protection, and commodity
chemical blending.

### Operational Efficiency & Fleet Logistics

Backed by our extensive blending capacity, a private logistics fleet, and strategic regional
distribution hubs, we maintain total supply chain security and eliminate field delivery volatility.

### Data-Driven Customization & Program Validation

Through the automated reporting power of SMART View® and I/O Pro Mega, we provide real-time
consumption mapping and digital tracking receipts, ensuring complete programmatic transparency and
optimized chemical loading.

### Reduce Costs. Maximize Reliability. Drive Performance.

[Consult a Smart Chemical Expert][26]

## Geleneksel Ağaçlandırmanın
## Sınırlarını Aşıyoruz

Üç temel prensip üzerine inşa edilmiş, ölçülebilir ve sürdürülebilir bir ağaçlandırma sistemi.

[Sıfır Saha İzi]

### Sıfır Saha İzi

Doğayı teknolojiyle yeşertiyoruz. Drone teknolojisi kullanarak tohum topu ekim faaliyetleri
yapıyoruz. İnsansız hava araçları teknolojisi ile hem arazi tahribatını sıfıra indiriyoruz hem de
sarp bölgelerde doğal yaşamı aynen koruyoruz.

%100Doğa Korumalı
[Şeffaf Tedarik Zinciri]

### Şeffaf Tedarik Zinciri

Yöreye uygun tohumlarımız ilgili Orman Bölge Müdürlüklerinden tedarik edilmekte; tohumların tür
bilgisi, ağaçlardan toplanma tarihleri, orijin bilgileri blok zinciri teknolojisiyle güvenle
doğrulanmaktadır.

%100İzlenebilirlik
[Yıllık Drone Raporlama]

### Yıllık Drone Raporlama

Periyodik uçuş verileri, büyüme metrikleri ve karbon nötrleme sonuçlarınız kurumsal panomuzda anlık
olarak güncellenir; doğrudan ESG raporlarınıza aktarılabilir.

12 ayİzleme
Süreç

## Dört Adımda
## Tam Otomasyon

Tohum seçiminden ESG raporlamasına kadar uçtan uca bilim ve teknoloji.

[Tohum Topu Ar-Ge]
01

### Tohum Topu Ar-Ge

Ekosistem restorasyonu ile yanan alanların ve maden sahalarının rehabilitasyonu için uzman orman
mühendislerimiz ve akademik danışmanlarımızla çalışıyoruz. Bölgenin iklim ve ekolojisine uygun
seçtiğimiz tohumları, ormancılık bilimi ışığında en doğru materyallerle kaplayarak tohum topu
formüllerimizi geliştiriyoruz.

[Hedef Alan Analizi]
02

### Hedef Alan Analizi

Uygulamamız; uydu ve drone (İHA) görüntülerini analiz ederek sahanın topografik yapısını, toprağın
nem içeriği ve ekosistemin yapısını inceler. Tohum topu atışı için en doğru hedef alanları yapay
zekâ ile belirler. Orman Bölge Müdürlüğü koordinasyonuyla yasal izinleri alarak ormanlaştırma
süreçlerini tamamen bilimsel ve güvenli hale getirir.

[Dronla Dağıtım]
03

### Dronla Dağıtım

Yüksek hassasiyetli GPS verileriyle yönlendirilen İHA filomuz, sıfır ekolojik tahribat prensibiyle
tek bir uçuşta 200+ tohum topunu önceden optimize edilmiş hedef noktalara hatasız şekilde
ulaştırıyoruz.

[Yıllık İzleme & ESG]
04

### Yıllık İzleme & ESG

Yıllık İHA fotogrametrisi ile izlenen vejetasyon büyüme verileri ve kurumsal gösterge panelinde
gerçek zamanlı sunulan karbon denkleştirme metrikleri anlık olarak görülür. ESG raporlama
süreçlerine entegre edilebilir.

⊹ Lab Analiz · KIL/GÜBRE/TOHUM
pH 6.8 · NPK Optimal
RTK · 36.78°N · 31.43°E
⊹ Hassas Hedef · 200+ tohum
⊹ Toprağa İndi · Çimlenme: %65+

Adım 01

### Laboratuvar

Orman mühendisleri kil + organik gübre + yerli tohum oranlarını analiz eder, tohum topunu formüle
eder.

Adım 02

### Dronla Yolculuk

GPS hassasiyetli drone tohum topunu hedef koordinata otonom uçar — bir uçuşta 200+ tohum.

Adım 03

### Toprağa Buluşma

Yağmurla birlikte kil çözülür, tohum filizlenir. Çimlenme oranı %65+ — geleneksel yöntemin 3 katı.

Tohumun YolculuğuLab → Drone → Toprak

## Etkinizi
## Anında Görün

Tohum sayısını, yılı ve çimlenme oranını ayarlayın — kaç ağaç yetişeceğini, kaç ton karbonun
nötrleneceğini canlı izleyin.

İzleme Süresi10 yıl
Çimlenme Oranı%65

### Yanan Ormanları Yeniden Yeşertiyoruz

Yanan orman arazilerinin ekolojik dinamiklerini geri kazandırmak için otonom drone filoları ve
yüksek çimlenme oranlarına sahip tohum toplarımızla, geniş ölçekli alanlarda hızlı ve sürdürülebilir
biçimde yeniden ormanlaştırma sürdürüyoruz.
* İş güvenliği: Yangın sonrası gevşeyen toprak ve heyelan riskinde insan hayatını riske atmaz
* Altın zaman dilimi: Toprak besin değerini kaybetmeden, erozyon başlamadan hızla müdahale
* GIS ile homojen dağılım: m² başına düşen tohum miktarı hassas ayarlanır
* Dijital izlenebilirlik: Her koordinat kayıt altında, çimlenme uydudan takip edilir

## Skytech Green Farkı
## Altı Temel Üstünlük

Geleneksel ağaçlandırmadan dronlu ekime, her noktada ölçülebilir avantaj sağlıyoruz.

### Hızlı Ekim

Bir drone uçuşunda 200+ tohum. Geleneksel yöntemlere kıyasla 10 kat hız.

### Sıfır Saha Tahribatı

# Schützen Sie Ihre IT-Infrastruktur vor Hackern und Schadcode

## Mit dem meistgenutzten Open Source Vulnerability Management der Welt

Jeder Cyberangriff braucht eine passende Schwachstelle, um erfolgreich zu sein. Unsere Mission ist
es, Sicherheitslücken und Schwachstellen in der IT aufzudecken, bevor sie ausgenutzt werden können.
Wir reduzieren das Risiko und die Auswirkungen von Cyberangriffen auf Unternehmen, Organisationen
und Arbeitsplätze um bis zu 99,9 %.

Unsere [Schwachstellenmanagement-Lösungen][98] nutzen eine stetig wachsende Zahl an
Schwachstellentests, die wir täglich um neue Einträge erweitern. Die Erfolgsrate aufgedeckter
Schwachstellen (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures, CVE) liegt damit deutlich höher als bei den
Lösungen unserer Marktbegleiter.

Unser Schwachstellenmanagement ist in drei Produktlinien erhältlich: als dedizierte
[Hardware-Appliance][99], als [virtuelle Maschine (VM)][100], kompatibel mit allen gängigen
Hypervisoren, sowie als unsere Einstiegslösung [OPENVAS BASIC][101]. Mit über 100.000 Installationen
und mehr als 100 Partnerunternehmen kommt unser Schwachstellenmanagement rund um den Globus zum
Einsatz. Testen Sie uns!
* 99 % weniger Angriffsfläche durch Vulnerability Management
* Mehr als 15 Jahre Produkterfahrung und Marktakzeptanz
* Über 100.000 Installationen weltweit
* Mehr als 150 Länder, in denen unsere Lösungen zum Einsatz kommen
* 9 von 10 Kunden behalten unsere Lösung nach der Testphase

# Together we can do even better chemistry.

## Green Chemical Design - How to meet an urgent industry need

### Purpose

To be a leader in the response to the demand for a fully sustainable chemicals industry, by helping
to introduce new solutions to serious needs for substitution of hazardous substances, and
development of new green chemistry

### Business Model

To participate in and facilitate multidisciplinary teams involving all stakeholders in the
development of new products. This includes business leaders and scientists. We have the team players
needed to deliver new strategies for `safe and sustainable by design` chemistry.

### Principles

Our innovations fully-recognise green chemistry principles, and our work is not driven by profit but
by the need for change towards a sustainable industry. The challenges require broad knowledge of all
aspects of the industry and the use of the necessary skills, from computational chemistry, hazard,
risk, engineering, and more.

### Impact

To help facilitate the reduction in the use of hazardous substances by the optimal use of those
substances that are already well-understood and by innovation. The long-term viability of the
chemical industry depends on its regeneration in a cost-effective way.

## Value Proposition

We provide value in our technical strengths and understanding the strategy for development of new
commercially-viable approaches.

see the [Business Context][14]

**New chemicals come from**
* **novel ideas** on how to substitute and avoid use of toxic substances
* techniques for the **simultaneous** consideration of the desired performance of a product and its
  hazard or risk
* the use of highly **biodegradable** substances
* essential **R&D** and **regulatory experience**
* use of **risk characterisation** as part of the comparison of alternatives

Concepts such as ‘safe and sustainable by design’, ‘safe by design’, ‘functional substitution’, ‘eco
innovation’, ‘sustainable chemistry’, ‘green chemistry’ etc are all implied by this proposition.

Regulatory compliance services are not provided by GCD; we recommend [Peter Fisk Associates
Limited][15] for top-quality consultancy

_crawl.linkedin_about: Hi there, we’re IAAM, a Vancouver-based technology firm that specializes in recruitment. We’re here to bring you an innovative online platform for video resume streaming to shake up the talent acquisition process by placing candidate personalities at its centre. Instead of your traditional resume submission – a Word document or PDF in plain text – our platform allows candidates to introduce themselves to potential employers through a video resume highlighting their character while also speaking to their professional experience. Employers can browse through these video resumes, make formal interview requests, and send out job offers – all in IAAM. What’s In (Our) Name? We chose the name IAAM pronounced "I AM" – and short for "It’s All About Me" – to empower candidates. Over the years, we’ve helped countless individuals find jobs, and while we got to know the amazing personalities of many of these individuals, employers were hesitant to consider them on paper. When you work in recruitment, it quickly becomes clear that candidates who might not tick every single box get passed over for candidates that do, but the candidates that do don’t necessarily come with a personality you’d want to work with. Of course this isn’t always the case, but we wanted to create a platform for candidates struggling in their job search to let employers get to know them on their terms – and, of course, to help employers find those shining personalities buried deep in stacks of resumes. From all of us at IAAM, we say : Candidates, it’s really nice to meet you!

“The India government has now mandated that the three large companies that own 70% of the oil
refineries in India must purchase biodiesel on a “Cost Plus“ basis… The airline industry should do
the same in order to rapidly grow the production of sustainable aviation fuel in order to
decarbonize aviation… The actual problem we have is that we are not serious about the adoption of
renewable fuels. That is a political problem, not an industry problem.”

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

# Azelis is the reference innovation service provider in the speciality chemicals and food
# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]
* [International supply chain][79]

.

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

.

### Customer Portal

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.
From one digital experience you can order samples, request quotes and reorder products from Azelis.

Register at [Explore.Azelis.com][82]

[Visit the Customer Portal ][83]

.

### Sustainability

At Azelis, we are committed to maintaining high human, environmental and ethical values. That is
only possible thanks to the cooperation of local communities, industry bodies, authorities, and/or
regulators, and with you.* *
* [Our sustainability programme][84]
* [Our 2025 Integrated Report][85]
* [Our sustainability policies][8 [Skip to main content][1]

## We are Azelis

Together with our 65,000+ customers we provide effective, sustainable and reliable business
solutions, developing innovative ways to create value. We are Azelis.

### Work with us

We currently employ more than 4,100 people across the world in 64 countries. We value highly
competent, forward-looking people.

Are you looking to work for a highly dynamic and innovative company where you can unleash your
talent? [Then you’re in the right place.][93]

[Discover our career opportunities][94]

### Corporate social responsibility

We take our responsibilities seriously and work with employees and stakeholders to reduce the
environmental impact of our work and to improve the social value in what we do, wherever we get the
opportunity.

***Against slavery and human trafficking***

We are committed to ensuring modern slavery does not take place within our business or supply
chains.

# The trusted global distributor and development partner for ingredients and specialty chemical
# solutions

At Caldic, partnerships come first. We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to enable
them to bring breakthrough innovations to market across the life science and material science
sectors. By combining technical expertise, local presence and a people-driven mindset, we go beyond
supply chain excellence to spark what’s next in healthier living and sustainable materials. 

[Explore our solutions][37]

## We go beyond distribution to co-create solutions that enable our customers to create entirely new
## product categories.
* ### Co-create tailored solutions
  
  We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to develop tailored solutions grounded in deep
  technical, market, and local expertise.
* ### Breakthrough innovations
  
  With over 70 application laboratories worldwide, our R&D teams co-create formulations that deliver
  superior quality and greater market value.
* ### Beyond supply chain excellence
  
  Our advanced supply chain facilities deliver custom-blended and packed solutions that reduce
  complexity, accelerate speed-to-market and get high-quality products production-ready.
* ### Global reach, local precision
  
  With teams in 44 countries, we combine global sourcing with local delivery to scale fast and meet
  market demands with deep insight and technical agility.

## Our Sustainability Report 2025 is here

Discover how we're turning our purpose, 'Because we care', into measurable progress across our
business. Explore our latest sustainability achievements, ESG initiatives, and the actions we're
taking to create long-term value for our people, customers, partners, and communities.

[**Read the report**][38]

[Cover page of the Caldic Sustainability Report 2025 showcasing the company’s sustainability
performance, ESG priorities, and commitment to responsible growth across its global operations]

## Solutions that go beyond distribution 

By connecting our market insight and entrepreneurial mindset with our deep customer understanding,
we develop tailored solutions across food, (bio)pharma, personal care and industrial applications.
From formulation to delivery, every detail reflects our care. With insight and agility, we help
simplify supply chains and unlock value at every step. 

[Discover our market solutions][39]

## Rooted in local teams, connected across the globe 

With teams in 44 countries and facilities across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific, we combine
global sourcing with local last-mile delivery. Our on-the-ground experts build strong customer
relationships and respond with speed, insight and precision. From sourcing and reformulating to
blending, labeling and resizing, our regional agility drives growth in dynamic, fast-moving markets.
We deliver fast, custom solutions - from bakery mixes to specialty pharma-grade solvents for nearby
hospital hubs. 

[Discover our global reach][40]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

At Champion, we deliver excellence across Infrastructure, Industrial, Commercial, Nuclear, and
Environmental projects—solving problems, raising standards, and exceeding expectations every day.

### How We Do It

## Industries
* Infrastructure
* Industrial
* Commercial
* Specialty & Nuclear

[access equipment]

### Infrastructure

We deliver high-performance, long-lasting solutions for complex environments for a wide range of
infrastructure, from bridges and tunnels to wastewater tanks. With integrated capabilities our team
ensures the safety, durability, and precision every project demands while protecting and restoring
infrastructure across the U.S.

[ See all Infrastructure Services ][58]
[Painting Coating]

### Industrial

We perform a variety of services including fireproofing, corrosion-resistant coatings, and
structural repair supported by our access, welding and rehabilitation capabilities to ensure
longevity of industrial environments.

[ See All Industrial Services ][59]
[Commercial]

### Commercial

We combine technical expertise with a detail-driven approach across our services including painting,
decorative finishes, drywall and flooring. With specialized access capabilities and high-performance
coatings, we ensure each project is completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest standard,
enhancing both form and function in commercial spaces.

[ See all Commercial Services ][60]
[Specialty Nuclear]

### Specialty & Nuclear

We deliver critical support for specialty and nuclear projects, from outage execution to abatement,
demolition, and secure upgrades. We operate under the industry’s highest safety and regulatory
standards, bringing precision and accountability to every high-stakes job.

[ See all Specialty & Nuclear Services ][61]
[Enviromental]

### Environmental

Our team provides end-to-end support from emergency response to hazardous material abatement and
site remediation, backed by advanced technologies, specialized equipment, and certified personnel
training programs.

[ See All Environmental Services ][62]

### OUR PRIORITIES

### SAFETY

Safety isn’t just a priority; it is the foundation of everything we do.

[View Safety Standards][63]

### QUALITY

Nothing short of
exceptional will do

### ACCOUNTABILITY

We value accountability from start to finish.

[Learn About Our Culture][65]

**Exceptional Is Our Standard.** We uphold the highest standards of safety, quality, and
accountability in every project. Our team’s top priority is to meet the highest standards of each
job site even in highly regulated environments like nuclear power generation and government DOD
sites. Our standards are enforced by our culture of accountability.

[View Our Standards][66]

**Global chemicals distributors**

Since 1926, **Faravelli Group** has specialized in the **distribution of ingredients and chemical
raw materials for industry**, supporting companies worldwide in their growth and helping them stand
out in increasingly complex markets.

Founded in Milan in 1926 by **Giusto Faravelli**, the Group has grown from a family-owned Italian
company into an **international organization**, while preserving a strong identity rooted in its
origins.

Headquartered in Milan, Faravelli Group operates through a network of directly owned companies in
**Italy, Germany, the Czech Republic, the Slovak Republic, Hungary, Spain, China and the United
States**.
This structure allows us to act as a truly integrated group, combining global reach with local
expertise and proximity to our customers.

Across all markets, Faravelli Group is active in the distribution of ingredients and chemical raw
materials for the **food, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, animal nutrition and industrial
chemical sectors**, offering technical expertise and deep market knowledge tailored to each industry
and geography.

Over the past hundred years, technologies, markets and business needs have evolved.
What has never changed is the Group’s way of working: **attention to people, uncompromising quality
standards, transparency and the ability to build solid, long-lasting relationships** with customers
and partners.

Today, Faravelli Group is **more than a distributor**. We are a **strategic partner**, providing an
integrated approach that combines top-quality ingredients with **technical support, application
consultancy, marketing, innovation and efficient logistics solutions**. This approach enables our
customers to move confidently from formulation to market — all the way to the final consumer.

In 2026, Faravelli Group celebrates **one hundred years of history** — not as a finish line, but as
a new starting point.
Always alongside companies, with vision and expertise, helping them grow, compete and **stand out**.

**Stand out with Faravelli Group, your best ingredient.**

#### Who We Are

We are a young & energetic industrial chemical distribution company with in-depth knowledge of
Products, Markets & emerging technologies. We strongly believe in upholding ethics while transacting
and nurturing long-term win-win relationships.

#### What We Do

We supply finest chemical products that are used to make and improve quality of Coatings, Varnishes,
Inks, Graphic Arts, Plastics & Rubbers. We are proven at delivering our promises in Middle-East Asia
& South-East Asia, Africa and Indian Subcontinent. We offer tailor-made products for specific
requirements of the formulator on exclusive basis.

**Principals** who are pioneers in the industry and making premium products with focus on market

economically. Most importantly, **Clients** who place trust in us

# **Welcome to Jebsen & Jessen Ingredients**

****

**Jebsen & Jessen Ingredients** is a leading distributor and solutions provider of specialty
chemicals and life science ingredients in Southeast Asia. We connect global technology leaders with
manufacturers to deliver more than just products — we offer tailored solutions to formulation,
material, and process challenges. With over 60 years of regional experience and teams on the ground
in Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam, we bring deep
local knowledge and hands-on technical support to every project. Our seven business lines span
Coating & Resins, Plastics & Rubber, Performance Chemicals, Feed, Food, Pharmaceuticals, and
Personal Care. Known for our professionalism, reliability, and long-standing partnerships, we’re
here to help our customers innovate and grow.

[Learn more about us][35]

### We are here to support you!

# **Working With Us**

Apart from world-class product solutions and a strong technical team, our clients can also benefit
from our other services.

[handshake icon]

#### World-class Infrastructure

From state-of-the-art warehousing processes and labs, to modern IT systems, our infrastructure
allows us to serve our clients better.

[database icon]

#### SAP Integrated

All of our offices and infrastructure run on one SAP system. This gives us and our partners full
transparency of our supply chain processes.

[regulatory affairs icon]

#### Regulatory Affairs

Asia’s regulations can be difficult to navigate. Our local experts provide a deep understanding of
local policies to ensure full compliance.

[customer service icon]

#### Customer Service teams

Our local customer service teams in each country make sure customers can rely on us. They are there
for our clients every step of the way.

[certification icon]

#### ISO Certifications

Our entities and infrastructure are certified to the latest ISO standards, allowing us to
continuously improve the quality of our operations.

[compliance icon]

#### Compliance & Anti-Corruption

Strong compliance and anti-corruption practices across all of our departments help us create trust
with our technology partners and customers.

# **Latest News**

company events, activities, and updates, but also through insightful articles shared by our
colleagues. Check out our [**newsroom**][45] for more news and stay connected with what’s happening
across the region.

# Welcome to K K Chem India Pvt Ltd.

We are among the fastest growing chemical distribution companies in India.

[Our Principals][9]

## About Us

K K Chem India Pvt Ltd. (formerly K. K. Chempro (I) Pvt. Ltd. (ISO 9001 company)) is one of the
fastest growing speciality chemical distribution companies in India and represents the most reputed
global chemical companies for various regions and product lines. The company and its group of
companies and diversification have reached a turnover of nearly 30 million USD.

KKCIPL specialises in distributing Silicone/Acrylic/Silica/Surfactants/Amines/Solvents and many more
chemistries in the diversified market. The major market coverage is with Convertors. The industries
catered to are PAPER/PLASTICS/TEXTILES/AGRO/CONSTRUCTION/CHEMICAL INTERMEDIATES/PETROLEUM and many
more.

KKCIPL has received several accolades from its PRINCIPALS for new product launches, technical
support, development and identifying market gaps.

[Company Information][10]

K K Chem India Pvt Ltd. has successfully completed the assessment conducted by Great Place To Work®,
India, and is certified as a great workplace.

Category: Under 100 Employees

[View Certification][11]

## Our Principals

#### Over the years, we have partnered with a global network of distributors to ensure we can
#### deliver anywhere around the world. Each of our channel partners bestows us with 100% of their
#### trust.

[][12]

#### [Dow Consumer Solutions][13]

Dow Consumer Solutions represents silicone-based product lines under the brand name ‘Dowsil’. Its
top market constitutes mobility, building construction & infrastructure, film tapes & release
liners, beauty & personal care and many more.

[Learn More][14]

[][15]

#### [Dow Industrial Solutions][16]

Dow Industrial Solutions contains product lines based on plastics, industrial intermidiates,
polyurethanes, coatings etc.

[Learn More][17]

[][18]

#### [Dupont Multibase][19]

Product line is related to material reinforcement with Si Additives. Various silicone masterbatches
compounds cater to automotive for interior solutions, compounding etc.

[Learn More][20]

[][21]

#### [Evonik][22]

One of the leading & largest companies in the world manufacturing the most specialised fumed and
precipitated silica for different applications such as antifoams, coatings etc.
[Learn More][23]
[][24]

#### [3M][25]

3M is the leading company in the world for speciality textile coatings representing ‘PM (PROTECTIVE
MATERIAL) SERIES’, a fluoro-chemical free chemistry.

[Learn More][26]

[][27]

#### [Clariant][28]

As a global provider of solutions for the textile industry, Clariant offers historical expertise to
improve the quality of fibres and garments.

[Learn More][29]

[][30]

#### [Azelis][31]

A leading chemical distribution company representing key brands of detergent & textile
intermediates.

[Learn More][32]

## Client Testimonials

“My association with K. K. Chemicals goes back more than 17 years. K. K. Chempro and K. K. Chemicals
are very trustworthy, technically qualified company.

Nitin Sethi, the director, is well-versed and has huge infield experience in many silicone products.
The staff is very courteous and helpful in a best possible way.

They have helped us many times with the perfectly right information. My best wishes and full thumbs
up to them.”

## Capturing Carbon. Fueling the Future.

At LanzaTech, we’re turning waste carbon into new beginnings.

Using our proprietary bio-fermentation technology, we transform industrial emissions, carbon
dioxide, and gasified waste into **ethanol**—a building block for a wide range of sustainable
products, including **Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF)** and other critical chemical derivatives.

With **six commercial facilities** already in operation and more on the way, we’re scaling fast to
meet the world’s growing demand for fuels and materials. Our technology helps industrial sectors by
unlocking value from emissions that would otherwise go to waste.

Together with our partners, we’re building a **circular carbon economy**—where carbon is
continuously reused, not released.

[Learn more][26]

## CARBON CAPTURE & UTILIZATION

We partner with energy-intensive industries to capture and process carbon-rich gases before they
enter the atmosphere. We then give that carbon a second life by partnering with suppliers and brands
to integrate recycled carbon into their supply chains to make new products and materials.

What was once a vision is now delivering measurable results across heavy industry. Our technology is
enhancing energy security, building resilient operations worldwide, and—together with our
partners—reinforcing critical supply chains. 

## Leadership

## Dr. Jennifer Holmgren

## /

## CEO

Jennifer is the Chief Executive Officer of LanzaTech. Jennifer has over 20 years of experience in
the energy sector including a proven track record in the development and commercialization of fuels
and chemicals technologies.


## THE PROCESS

LanzaTech is changing how people think about carbon by creating opportunities to create value from
waste

Play Video

## Capturing Carbon,
## Creating Value

## Environmental Impact

Life cycle analysis (LCA) is essential for understanding the environmental benefits of LanzaTech’s
technology. LanzaTech has developed in-house LCA expertise and engages in collaborations to
understand and develop recommendations for methodological approaches which vary by region. We
regularly work with specialists around the world including: The European Commission (EC)/ Joint
Research Council (JRC), Roundtable for Sustainable Biomaterials (RSB), International Civil Aviation
Organization (ICAO), International Sustainability & Carbon Certification (ISCC), California Air
Resources Board (CARB), Argonne National Laboratory (ANL), Michigan Technological University (MTU),
Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and others.

LCAs consider the impacts of producing and using all energy and chemical inputs into the final
product(s). Third party analyses are used wherever possible and are available to our customers. We
also conduct LCAs for peer review, using in-house engineering data and emission factors from
appropriate published LCA-specific databases and third-party market projections.

[Here you can find an example][27] of a peer reviewed LCA for carbon negative chemicals production,
published in [Nature Biotechnology.][28]

[Here is an example][29] of a third party LCA for high purity ethanol which includes transportation
to Europe. As more facilities using our technology come online globally, the impact of
transportation on the LCA will be greatly reduced. LanzaTech continues to conduct LCAs on each
facility, exploring different methodologies and parameters. We are currently completing an internal
review of an LCA of the same facility for fuel grade ethanol to the factory gate. This will be
published after it has been reviewed by a third party. Current estimates of the resulting LCA show a
significant reduction relative to high purity ethanol being shipped to Europe.

## Capturing Carbon. Fueling the Future.

At LanzaTech, we’re turning waste carbon into new beginnings.

Using our proprietary bio-fermentation technology, we transform industrial emissions, carbon
dioxide, and gasified waste into **ethanol**—a building block for a wide range of sustainable
products, including **Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF)** and other critical chemical derivatives.

With **six commercial facilities** already in operation and more on the way, we’re scaling fast to
meet the world’s growing demand for fuels and materials. Our technology helps industrial sectors by
unlocking value from emissions that would otherwise go to waste.

Together with our partners, we’re building a **circular carbon economy**—where carbon is
continuously reused, not released.

[Learn more][26]

## CARBON CAPTURE & UTILIZATION

We partner with energy-intensive industries to capture and process carbon-rich gases before they
enter the atmosphere. We then give that carbon a second life by partnering with suppliers and brands
to integrate recycled carbon into their supply chains to make new products and materials.

What was once a vision is now delivering measurable results across heavy industry. Our technology is
enhancing energy security, building resilient operations worldwide, and—together with our
partners—reinforcing critical supply chains.

## Environmental Impact

Life cycle analysis (LCA) is essential for understanding the environmental benefits of LanzaTech’s
technology. LanzaTech has developed in-house LCA expertise and engages in collaborations to
understand and develop recommendations for methodological approaches which vary by region. We
regularly work with specialists around the world including: The European Commission (EC)/ Joint
Research Council (JRC), Roundtable for Sustainable Biomaterials (RSB), International Civil Aviation
Organization (ICAO), International Sustainability & Carbon Certification (ISCC), California Air
Resources Board (CARB), Argonne National Laboratory (ANL), Michigan Technological University (MTU),
Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and others.

LCAs consider the impacts of producing and using all energy and chemical inputs into the final
product(s). Third party analyses are used wherever possible and are available to our customers. We
also conduct LCAs for peer review, using in-house engineering data and emission factors from
appropriate published LCA-specific databases and third-party market projections.

[Here you can find an example][27] of a peer reviewed LCA for carbon negative chemicals production,
published in [Nature Biotechnology.][28]

[Here is an example][29] of a third party LCA for high purity ethanol which includes transportation
to Europe. As more facilities using our technology come online globally, the impact of
transportation on the LCA will be greatly reduced. LanzaTech continues to conduct LCAs on each
facility, exploring different methodologies and parameters. We are currently completing an internal
review of an LCA of the same facility for fuel grade ethanol to the factory gate. This will be
published after it has been reviewed by a third party. Current estimates of the resulting LCA show a
significant reduction relative to high purity ethanol being shipped to Europe.
